name: calvary-scribblings
//: No image/build key: keep the Codespaces default universal image (unchanged from before this file existed). This config exists only to restore deploy credentials after a rebuild — the FIREBASE_SA_KEY Codespaces secret is written back to the gitignored serviceAccountKey.json so `npm run rules:deploy` and the rules:pull/check scripts keep working. The secret takes the whole key file, pasted as it is (it starts with "{" and is written straight through); the older base64 form is still decoded. printf, never echo: sh's echo turns the key's \n sequences into real line breaks and breaks the JSON. See RULES.md and security/KEY-ROTATION.md.
postCreateCommand: if [ -n "$FIREBASE_SA_KEY" ]; then v="$FIREBASE_SA_KEY"; case "${v#"${v%%[![:space:]]*}"}" in "{"*) printf "%s" "$v" > serviceAccountKey.json ;; *) printf "%s" "$v" | base64 -d > serviceAccountKey.json ;; esac; fi
